title: Previews regenerated legitimately by the export tool

case.facts: exports/previews/cover-preview.jpg has a new digest and modification time after the export tool regenerated it; the user declared exports/previews regenerable.
case.expected_text: The preview change is reported as informational. No incident, no recovery and no at-risk flag for the preview.

statements.STM-0001-0004: exports/previews is regenerated by our export tool; changes there are expected.
